harness.note: the real controller machine code over scripted pad input and a scripted clock; UI, sound and pad-read calls replaced by recorders. An independent Python model agreed on every exported vector.

description: Lulu's Fury: the rotation tables, the controller's result for scripted analog and digital pad streams, and the rotation ladders.
notes: class selector: for one spell variant (command id - 0x3078), out.rowByMagic[magic] is the digit row (0 to 16, class rows lists them) the real selector chose at Lulu's Magic 0 to 255, out.limit the time limit in seconds.

class analog-*/digital-*: in.stream is the stick, 4 hex digits (x, y) a pad sample, from sample 0; in.buttons is one digit a sample (bit 1 left, bit 2 right); in.frameTime is the clock step in seconds. out is the real controller's end state: casts reached (level), the progress counter, frames run, controller calls made, and the result passed (grade = casts, A = B = 0).
out.thresholds are the 16 cumulative thresholds the real set-up built. The dispatcher advances the pad once a frame and once more while the extra-poll flag is set (sample index k).

class ladder: out.levelsCw[n] and out.levelsCcw[n] are the casts after n exact rotations (n = 0 to 40) fed to the real controller; class ladder-digital: out.levelsByTwoSteps[i] is the casts after 2 i exact left/right pairs.
name: minigame_fury
